title: Targeted Learning for Inference on Data Fairness
abstract: arXiv:2502.04309v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As algorithmic decision making has become increasingly ubiquitous even in high-stakes settings, significant effort has been invested in defining, detecting, and eliminating unfair model-driven outcomes. Prior work has largely focused on estimating the fairness properties of a given predictive model, and quantifying uncertainty based on variability in a fixed model's performance across evaluation datasets. Alternatively, we can also ask about uncertainty that the model inherits from its training data; here we evaluate data fairness - fairness in the data generating process used for training. We perform inference on data fairness using targeted learning, a flexible framework for nonparametric inference, and derive estimators for demographic parity, equal opportunity, and conditional mutual information. Simulations show that our data fairness estimators improve confidence-interval coverage and reduce false detections of population

translated_title: 基于目标学习的数据公平性推断
translated_abstract: 随着算法决策即使在高风险场景中也变得日益普遍，人们在定义、检测和消除模型驱动的不公平结果方面投入了大量精力。先前的工作主要集中于估计给定预测模型的公平性属性，并基于固定模型在评估数据集上性能的变异性来量化不确定性。与此不同，我们还可以探讨模型从其训练数据中继承的不确定性；在此，我们评估的是数据公平性——即用于训练的数据生成过程中的公平性。我们使用目标学习（targeted learning）这一灵活的非参数推断框架对数据公平性进行推断，并推导出针对人口均等、机会均等和条件互信息的估计量。仿真结果表明，我们的数据公平性估计量提高了置信区间的覆盖率，并减少了对总体公平性的错误检测。
tldr: 该论文提出利用目标学习这一非参数推断框架对训练数据生成过程的公平性进行统计推断，推导出人口均等、机会均等和条件互信息的估计量，仿真表明其能提高置信区间覆盖率并减少误检。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes targeted learning-based inference on data fairness—fairness of the training data-generating process—deriving estimators for demographic parity, equal opportunity, and conditional mutual information, which improve confidence-interval coverage and reduce false detections.
